patches.name: workspace-git-snapshot-retention
patches.reason: Retain workspace Git snapshots across reconnects so clients read the last known state immediately and the daemon revalidates once instead of running a full initial refresh for every workspace.
patches.removeWhen: Upstream ships workspace Git snapshot retention across reconnects or fixes issue #7760.

Its tests require the upstream settle helpers and logger.info stub; use the advancing fake clock for recovery refresh assertions. Bound checkout inspection across all reconciliation projects with one service-owned p-limit queue of two. Preserve the unchanged workspace-create timing assertion under the explicitly approved baseline exception.
